decided.source: STAGE1_PLAN.md, section 9, 'Decisions taken during the build (step 3, 8 Nov)', decisions 11-13
decided.note: decided on reasons that do not depend on the gate's outcome; the results with the other choices stay recorded as evidence (here, and every panel run in reported_not_gated.plant_choices)

decisions.source: STAGE1_PLAN.md, section 9, 'Decisions taken during the build (step 3, 8 Nov)', decision 11
decisions.title: Ankle servo gains: joint space
decisions.reason: carpet.hold_servos defines one hold servo per joint for the screened model, which drives each ankle axis with one motor; applying that rule to each of the linkage's two motors doubles the ankle's joint-space stiffness, and half the gain per motor reproduces the screened stiffness exactly (the damping that results is in plant.json, gains.ankle_joint_space)

decisions.source: STAGE1_PLAN.md, section 9, 'Decisions taken during the build (step 3, 8 Nov)', decision 12
decisions.title: Ankle armature: the linkage's
decisions.reason: both motors' rotors are geared to both ankle axes, so each axis carries twice the screened single-motor armature: the physical two-motor ankle the plan specifies

decisions.source: STAGE1_PLAN.md, section 9, 'Decisions taken during the build (step 3, 8 Nov)', decision 13
decisions.title: G2 replay rule: a 20-start panel
decisions.reason: an open-loop replay has no feedback, so its fall time is chaotic (start offsets of 1 mm/s move one body's run from 25.8 to 5 strides); G2 is judged on the panel's median and the unperturbed run is reported

rules.panel: the median of 20 nominal replays with the envelope, from starts whose root velocity is offset in x and y by at most 1 mm/s (seed 0), is at least 10 strides (STAGE1_PLAN.md decision 13)
rules.single: the unperturbed nominal replay with the envelope walks at least 10 strides (plan section 3 step 3 as written)
